US Job Growth Rebounds in August, Unemployment Rate Holds Steady

The United States labor market saw a stronger-than-expected rebound in August, adding 162,000 nonfarm jobs. The unemployment rate remained at 4.1%, easing concerns about a potential summer slowdown. This performance provides the Federal Reserve with more flexibility to focus on controlling inflation. Some economists, however, described the report as 'disappointing' while noting it was too early to raise alarms.
